item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. With no notes today, start simple. Your day is packed with reminders, and meals are easy to skip or rush when that happens. Decide now what you'll eat at each meal, and include protein and something green. Eating on purpose is a form of the care you keep reminding yourself to practice. Action: before noon, plan tonight's dinner and put the ingredients out where you can see them.
